evidence.claim: The companion records adapter-only training, save, fresh-process reload, and held-out generation on CUDA and Apple Silicon.
The inherited upstream repository documents a full-SFT path separately from the Instavar LoRA addition.
The LoRA runner and inference path were exercised on the recorded CUDA host.
A bounded MPS LoRA step saved, reloaded, and generated a finite held-out WAV.
The upstream lineage exposes ONNX CPU inference, but adapter-aware export is not established here.
The upstream lineage exposes SGLang serving, but adapter-aware export is not established here.

rights.code: The repository declares Apache-2.0 for its code and bundled model lineage; pin and review every distributed artifact.
rights.weights: Pin and review the upstream model-weight terms separately from this repository's code license.
rights.dataset: Record dataset provenance, permitted use, and speaker consent before training.
rights.generated_output: Review the model and dataset terms for the intended generated-output use.

known_gaps: A one-step MPS preflight does not establish training quality or long-session stability.
Adapter-aware ONNX and SGLang exports have not passed conformance.
No selected adapter has passed blinded long-form Singapore English listening.
